Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound in the left lane approaching the intersection in Pearland, Texas, when the vehicle
was struck on the driver side by Driver 2, who was entering the intersection from a cross street. Driver 1 identified
himself as the registered policy holder for the vehicle and confirmed he was operating it at the time. A passenger was
seated in the front right seat and was also present at the scene, and witnesses at the corner independently identified
that person as being inside the vehicle during the collision. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was evaluated
on scene; the nature of the complaint is consistent with the force and direction of this type of impact. Driver 2 gave a
statement matching the sequence described by Driver 1, and two bystanders provided accounts that agree on the
signal phase and point of impact. Scene photographs show damage concentrated on the driver side door and quarter
panel, which corresponds with the reported impact angle. Several light scratches on the rear bumper appear older
and weathered, and may predate this incident; they were noted but not attributed to this collision. Reporting officer,
unit assigned.
